monthly_rent.line: The monthly licence fee/rent is ₹32,000, payable in advance by the third day of each month by electronic transfer.

security_deposit.line: The Occupant shall pay a refundable, interest-free security deposit of ₹1,92,000, equal to six months of the monthly fee, before receiving keys.

total_length.line: The term begins on 1 November 2026 and continues until 31 October 2028, for twenty-four months.

lock_in.line: The first eighteen months are a lock-in period binding on both parties.

lock_in_applies_to.line: The first eighteen months are a lock-in period binding on both parties.

tenant_notice.line: After the eighteen-month lock-in expires, either Party may terminate by giving ninety days’ written notice.

landlord_notice.line: After the eighteen-month lock-in expires, either Party may terminate by giving ninety days’ written notice.

tenant_can_leave_early.line: After the eighteen-month lock-in expires, either Party may terminate by giving ninety days’ written notice.

landlord_can_end_early.line: After the eighteen-month lock-in expires, either Party may terminate by giving ninety days’ written notice.

rent_increase.line: On each anniversary of the commencement date, the monthly fee increases by eight percent over the amount payable immediately before that anniversary.

maintenance.line: A monthly society service charge of ₹2,500 is payable by the Occupant in addition to the monthly fee.

deposit_refund_time.line: Within thirty calendar days after vacant possession, return of keys, and settlement of known charges, the Owner shall provide a written account of deductions and refund the undisputed balance.
